title: Mud, Then Baths
lines: Sal and Lin have big dogs.
They let them run up the hill.
Both dogs dig and get mud on their legs.
Sal fills a tub and Lin gets a rag.
"The dogs are in that tub!" said Sal.

questions.ask: How do the dogs get mud on them?
questions.listenFor: They dig on the hill. The third line says it - have your child find the word dig.

questions.ask: Where are the dogs at the end?
questions.listenFor: In the tub. If they say "they ran off," ask what happened after that.

questions.ask: Do you think the dogs like baths? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. Listen for a reason, like "yes, they got in the tub themselves."
